notes:
✨ Mantra Siddhi v0.9.10-beta update:
• ⏱️ Passcode Overlay & Resilient Background Updates: Downloading updates is no longer lost if you minimize the app or lock the screen.
• 📿 Log Chanting Session Refinements: Watermark 0 hint (no more deleting '0'), 'Mantras Done' renaming, and end-time capped to current time for today.
• 📊 Analytics Overhaul: Pacing & Forecast at the top, fixed 24 1-hour slots, and interactive Daily Trend bars that reveal the day's 24h hourly distribution.
• 👤 Mandatory Sadhaka Profile Details: Full Name, Date of Birth (DOB), Gender, and 10-digit Phone strictly verified.
• ☁️ Drive Auto-Restore on Onboarding: 1-tap backup restore upon Google sign-in.
• 🔒 Unified Security PIN Dialog: Centralized 4-digit PIN setup with biometrics, security questions, and offline 108108 master code.
• 🎨 Warm Ivory & Chandan Light Theme: Eliminated harsh glaring white for peaceful chanting.
• 🔔 Notification Height Fix: Timer chronometer no longer cut off in Android status bar.
